house.description: Liability for all corporate donations for death or injury to a participant resulting from the inherent risks of livestock activities limited.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to civil liability; limiting liability for all corporate donations for death or injury to a participant resulting from the inherent risks of livestock activities; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 604A.12, subdivision 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 604A.12, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Immunity from liability; livestock events.
A [-nonprofit-] corporation, association, or organization, or a person or other entity donating services, livestock, facilities, or equipment for the use of a [-nonprofit-] corporation, association, or organization, is not liable for the death of or an injury to a participant resulting from the inherent risks of livestock activities.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to causes of action accruing on or after that date. +]
